options.description: Draw the ASCII frames, `LINE`, when no `frames` are given. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says of `env` and `platform`, since a terminal that cannot draw box drawing cannot draw braille either. Explicit `frames` win.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: The frames to cycle: a set such as `ARC`, or an array of your own. Defaults to `DOTS`, or to `LINE` where the terminal cannot be trusted with braille.
options.name: frames

options.description: How long each frame lasts, in milliseconds. Defaults to the set's own interval, or 80 for a bare array.
options.name: interval

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

options.description: What it is doing, shown after the spinner.
options.name: text

registryDescription: An animated spinner that settles into a success or failure line
